national_law.name: Cybersecurity Law
national_law.note: Sectoral authorities serve as competent authorities

management_liability.description: Management can be held liable for infringements including personal fines and dismissal from role for a fixed period. Must approve risk-management measures and oversee implementation.

penalties.essential_entities: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of worldwide annual turnover
penalties.important_entities: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of worldwide annual turnover
penalties.note: Public administration exempt from administrative fines
